  2. Calculate the Total Bill Amount

    Step 1: Identify the given data

    From the invoice, the items and their totals are:

    1. वेफर बालाजी 100 ग्राम → ₹1050.00
    2. फोटो फ्रेम → ₹1400.00
    3. फ्रेर्विनाइनर यूरिया → ₹10500.00

    Tax details:

    • ₹11000.00 taxable at 5% → Tax = ₹550.00
    • ₹1250.00 taxable at 12% → Tax = ₹150.00

    Step 2: Calculate subtotal before tax

    Subtotal = ₹1050.00 + ₹1400.00 + ₹10500.00
    Subtotal = ₹12950.00 (matches invoice total before tax breakdown).

    Step 3: Verify tax calculation

    • 5% of ₹11000.00 = ₹550.00 ✅
    • 12% of ₹1250.00 = ₹150.00 ✅

    Step 4: Calculate final total

    Final Total = ₹12950.00 (includes tax as per invoice).

    Final Answer

    The total bill amount is ₹12950.00.
